content.text: That's just the example file (disabled by `if true then return {} end`). I'll create a new plugin spec file for diffview.

Done. Created `/Users/soph/.config/nvim/lua/plugins/diffview.lua`. The plugin will be installed automatically next time you open Neovim.

Keymaps added:
- `<leader>gd` — open diff view
- `<leader>gh` — file history for current file

The plugin is lazy-loaded and only activates when you use a keymap or run a `:Diffview*` command.
if I do `leader gd` I still get the old mapping which opens a build in git diff view
LazyVim maps `<leader>gd` to its built-in git diff. To override it, you need to disable the original binding. Let me update the file.

content.text: Added `{ "<leader>gd", false }` on the LazyVim spec to disable the built-in mapping. Restart Neovim and `<leader>gd` should now open Diffview.
